meta.disclaimer: This tool orders evidence-backed checks. It does not inspect a save or prove a cause.

title.en: Steam discussion: Real Eggs, Real Evidence
title.zh: Steam 讨论：Real Eggs, Real Evidence
Steam 讨论：旧版本鸡舍门口规避法

title.en: Steam moderator care answers retained in the animal evidence ledger
title.zh: 动物证据库中留存的 Steam 管理员照料答复

text.en: Update to 0.8.10.562 or later before testing again. The hotfix fixed several disappearance paths, so an older reproduction is historical evidence.
text.zh: 先更新到 0.8.10.562 或更高版本再复测。该热修已修复多条动物消失路径，旧版本复现只能算历史证据。

summary.en: Start with version and linkage checks. Do not demolish a current coop as the first response.
summary.zh: 先检查版本和鸡舍关联。当前版本不要一上来就拆鸡舍。

text.en: Walk to the coop door and look for a stock counter such as 0/6 or 3/6. No counter means the coop is not linked correctly.
text.zh: 走到鸡舍门口查看是否出现 0/6、3/6 之类的存栏计数。没有计数通常说明鸡舍没有正确关联。

text.en: Check the fence, gate and coop entrance. A bird may have wandered rather than disappeared if the outdoor route is open.
text.zh: 检查围栏、门和鸡舍入口。室外路线敞开时，鸡可能只是走远，并非真正消失。

text.en: Record the exact transition: night entry, growth, birth, loading, subway travel or a doorway. Those are the paths named in the official hotfix.
text.zh: 记录准确发生节点：夜间进建筑、长大、出生、读档、地铁运输还是门口。这些正是官方热修列出的路径。

text.en: If it still reproduces on 0.8.10.562+, keep the build, before/after count, coop counter, care state and a screenshot. Treat it as a residual report, not a known current cause.
text.zh: 如果 0.8.10.562+ 仍复现，保留版本号、前后数量、鸡舍计数、照料状态和截图；把它作为残留问题报告，不要先认定原因。

summary.en: Separate hand-feeding from trough behavior: hay can be hand-fed, but water comes from a trough.
summary.zh: 先区分手动喂食和食槽：干草可以手喂，饮水必须来自食槽。

text.en: Fill the trough inside the coop with the selected food and water. Daily care does not require a second outdoor trough while the coop remains accessible.
text.zh: 给鸡舍内食槽补充已选择的食物和水。鸡舍可正常进入时，日常照料不要求再放一个室外食槽。

text.en: Check after the next morning cycle. Documented trough feeding happens once in the morning and covers the day.
text.zh: 等到下一个早晨周期再检查。现有官方答复表明，动物每天早上从食槽进食一次并维持当天。

text.en: Do not use hand-fed hay as a water test. The water reserve refills from the trough, not from hand-feeding.
text.zh: 不要用手喂干草来判断饮水是否正常。饮水储备只能从食槽补充。

title.en: Chicken is sick or losing health

summary.en: Temperature equipment prevents stress; it does not cure an animal that is already sick.
summary.zh: 温控设备用于预防温度压力，不能治好已经生病的动物。

text.en: Confirm you bought the coop/barn heater or AC from Angela. The house decoration version sold at City Hall does nothing for a coop.
text.zh: 确认购买的是 Angela 出售的鸡舍/畜棚温控设备。市政厅出售的房屋装饰版对鸡舍无效。

text.en: Mount the coop heater on the outside wall and verify its building link with the hammer view.
text.zh: 把鸡舍温控装在外墙，并用锤子视图确认它与鸡舍已经关联。

text.en: If the chicken is already sick, use the veterinary route. Correct temperature control prevents future stress but is not a cure.
text.zh: 如果鸡已经生病，走兽医治疗路线。正确温控只能预防后续温度压力，不是治疗。

summary.en: Verify that the bird is an adult hen, then stabilize food, water, temperature and access before judging production.
summary.zh: 先确认是成年母鸡，再稳定食物、饮水、温控和鸡舍出入后判断产蛋。

text.en: Confirm the animal is an adult hen rather than a rooster or a chick. Do not use one morning as proof of a broken production cycle.
text.zh: 确认它是成年母鸡，而不是公鸡或雏鸡。不要用单个早晨就断定产蛋机制坏了。

text.en: Verify the interior trough has food and water, the coop is linked, and the correct temperature kit is installed.
text.zh: 确认鸡舍内食槽有食物和水、鸡舍已关联，并安装了正确的温控设备。

text.en: Observe more than one morning and record build, care bars and bird type. The site does not publish a guaranteed egg-per-day rate.
text.zh: 连续观察不止一个早晨，并记录版本、照料条和鸡的类型。本站没有发布“每天必出一个蛋”的保证值。

title.zh: Gigi 任务一直没有大鸡蛋

summary.en: Large eggs are RNG-based, so correct care improves the chance but does not guarantee the next batch.
summary.zh: 大鸡蛋受随机机制影响，正确照料只能提高机会，不能保证下一批一定出现。

text.en: Pet the hens daily to raise their rating and keep their normal care chain stable.
text.zh: 每天抚摸母鸡提高评级，并保持日常照料链稳定。

text.en: Provide an enclosed outdoor roaming area. Official guidance ties enclosed roaming to the chance of large eggs; it does not require an outdoor trough.
text.zh: 提供封闭的室外活动区。官方答复把封闭活动与大鸡蛋机会关联起来，但没有要求室外食槽。

text.en: Keep collecting normal batches. A player report saw large eggs only around the fourth or fifth batch; that is an example, not a guaranteed threshold.
text.zh: 继续收取普通批次。有玩家到第 4–5 批才遇到大鸡蛋；这只是案例，不是保证阈值。

title.en: Auto-feeding or water setup does nothing
title.zh: 自动喂食或供水没有工作

summary.en: The automation chain fails when any link, setting or contract is missing.
summary.zh: 自动化链路只要缺少连接、设置或合同中的任意一项，就可能不工作。

text.en: Mount the Auto-Feeding Kit on the coop and verify the kit is linked to that building.
text.zh: 把自动喂食套件装到鸡舍上，并确认套件已与这座鸡舍关联。

text.en: Place a silo inside link range and load it with hay. Use the hammer view to inspect the connection.
text.zh: 把装有干草的筒仓放在关联范围内，用锤子视图检查连接。

text.en: Place the water tower within its shorter link radius and sign the water contract with the mayor at City Hall. A tower alone does not refill.
text.zh: 把水塔放在较短的关联半径内，并在市政厅与市长签水务合同。只有水塔不会自动补水。

text.en: Choose the food and water types on the coop trough, turn the system on, and look for the green light that confirms a complete setup.
text.zh: 在鸡舍食槽上选择食物和水的类型，打开系统，并确认出现代表链路完整的绿灯。
